skills_considered.reason: Used for the retrieval sweep that produced this session's 24 new structured surfaces. For THIS paper the XML was already on disk from an earlier supplier pass; the figures and the supplementary PDF were fetched during this reading from the publisher CDN after oa.fcgi returned idIsNotOpenAccess.

Run inline. The load-bearing findings here are text-versus-panel disagreements, and a read-only sub-agent with Read/Grep/Glob cannot inspect a JPEG at original resolution — delegating would have produced a reading of the running text, which is the half that is wrong.

One discovery-grade lead was surfaced and is recorded as a locator rather than promoted: hepatic steatosis on NORMAL chow, visible in Fig 2h and named nowhere in the text. Promoting it needs a quantified lipid measurement this paper does not report.

Digoxin appears as a tool compound, not a proposed therapy. A cardiac glycoside with a narrow therapeutic index and no CNS rationale here does not reach BLOCK-1 triage on the strength of a mouse liver-tumour experiment whose two strongest targets were not measured.

Review floor checked and NOT met, deliberately and with the check written down. The audit is required when a reading would narrow, reverse, corroborate or remove a `consolidated baseline` claim, or justify a MAJOR working-model bump. The claims this hepatic reading touches are CLAIM 025 (WWOX/HIF1A ratio) and CLAIM 009 (mitochondrial/metabolic), and BOTH carry Status `in observation`. The three `consolidated baseline` claims in the registry (012, 017, 019) are human clinical-genotype claims that this mouse hepatic paper does not reach. No MAJOR bump is proposed; the commit candidate is MINOR and adds boundaries rather than reversing a baseline.

The supplement's discovery-grade leads (CTGF/YAP time course, the context-dependence of the glycolytic target set, serum ALT under HFD) are recorded as locators and as a discovery-ledger append. Running the cumulative discovery skill on top would restate them in a second place without adding a source.

No molecule is promoted by this reading. Digoxin appears as the paper's own tool compound and this reading NARROWS what it demonstrates (entries[9], entries[16], entries[17]); narrowing a compound's evidence does not promote it, so BLOCK-1 has nothing to gate.

performed_again.finding: Exactly one receipt exists for this PMID (FTR-20260810-29724996-01, partial) and it leaves exactly one section uncovered: supplementary, recorded `not_read`. retraction_check.result: No retraction and no expression of concern. One ORDINARY ERRATUM is attached: 'Erratum in' Cell Death Dis 2018 Nov 23;9(12):1159, PMID 30470736, recording that duplication had mistakenly occurred in the Fig 3A and D H&E panels. Per the corpus rule an ordinary erratum is annotated and does NOT create a PUBLICATION_INTEGRITY_HOLD. The surface read here is the corrected version: the XML carries a Change history entry dated 11/23/2018, so the Fig 3 panels inspected below are post-correction. The erratum itself was retrieved as a structured surface during this session's sweep. RE-CHECKED 2026-09-09 on the freshly acquired Europe PMC deposit: the erratum (PMID 30470736) remains an ordinary Author Correction, no retraction and no expression of concern. The 2026-09-09 resume additionally reads the correction itself as its own assigned PMID in the same wave, so the erratum stops being an annotation on this record and becomes a read source.
retraction_check.corrected_items_provenance: Declared from the erratum's own words, read as its own source on 2026-09-09 (PMID 30470736, FTR-20260909-30470736-01): 'duplication had mistakenly occurred in Fig. 3a and d-panels that display H&E'. source_artifacts.extraction: pdftotext -raw -nopgbrk (poppler) over PMID29724996_AbuRemaileh2018_supplement.pdf, whose SHA-256 reproduces the digest fingerprinted by the 2026-08-10 reading. -nopgbrk is a re-derivation, not a post-hoc strip: the page-break U+000C the default emitter inserts is a delimiter pdftotext adds, not a glyph of the document, and the protocol forbids cleaning a surface after the fact.

verbatim_locators.abstract_anchoring_waived: No locator is abstract-anchored and none could be. The abstract states only that WWOX loss accelerates HCC through HIF1alpha; it contains none of the timing, none of the gene-panel asymmetry and none of the panel disagreements this reading turns on.
verbatim_locators.panel_text_relation_note: Every entry carries panel_text_relation. Six findings are contradictions, and in each the assertion that another locator is false is made by the PANEL: the figure entry carries text_contradicted_by_panel plus contradicts: entries[N], and the sentence it overturns is an ordinary text_only locator. This manifest was first written with the marker on both members and a symmetric evidence_pair key; that was wrong on both counts — the claim is one-directional, and entries[N] is the indexing grammar adjudications.json already uses, so it should have been reused rather than coined. RETROFIT 2026-08-10, citation audit: every contradicted sentence now carries the author's own figure citation inside its snippet, and every panel entry carries a needle drawn from that snippet plus a cited_panel_check stating whether the panel it reads is the panel the sentence cites. Five of six pairs pass — 2e, 4a-b, 3f, 5d-f, 7d are each cited by the sentence they falsify. The sixth does not: 'it continued rising' names no figure, and its citation is inherited from the sentence before it. That inheritance is now declared on both members instead of being invisible. Nothing was re-pointed to make a pair work; the one weak pair is labelled weak and kept.

entries.proposition: CROSS-PAPER OVER-EXTENSION BY LOST QUALIFIER — not a contradiction, and the distinction is the finding. Reference 24 is Iatan 2014, PMID 24871327, which reports lowered HDL-C in the TOTAL-BODY null and separately reports that the sole deletion of Wwox in hepatocytes did NOT change HDL-C in either sex. This Discussion drops the genotype qualifier, writing 'Wwox knockout mouse models' without restriction, inside a paragraph whose entire subject is the liver. The cited result is real; the scope it is carried at is not. That is the failure mode to tag, because a reader checking whether the source says something about HDL will find that it does.

S3A does not show a uniform sub-significant drift: two of the five glycolytic targets carry significance marks (PKM2 and PDK1) and three do not (LDHA1, HK2, GLUT1). 'A tendency' understates the two marked genes and overstates the three null ones, so the panel neither simply confirms nor simply contradicts the sentence — it splits it. entries.proposition: THE BOUNDARY ON THE PAPER'S CENTRAL POSITIVE RESULT, VISIBLE ONLY IN THE SUPPLEMENT. The ChIP experiment of Fig 4f — HIF1alpha occupancy on glycolytic promoters, the third side of the hepatic triangle recorded at entries[0] — was run with exactly five promoter primer pairs: PKM, GAPDH, HK2, Glut1 and Aldoa, plus two negative-region controls. PDK1 and LDHA1 are NOT among them. So the promoter-occupancy claim does not extend to the two targets that carry the strongest cross-paper bridges in this repository, and no locator anywhere in the corpus should be read as though it did. The main text names the five genes but the primer roster is what proves the set is closed.

entries.proposition: THE CONTROL THAT STRENGTHENS THE HIGH-FAT-DIET RESULT, AND IT EXISTS ONLY IN THE SUPPLEMENT. Under high-fat diet the control and knockout weight curves are superimposed across all 19 sampled points. The HFD tumour difference of Fig 6a (11/12 versus 4/18) therefore cannot be attributed to the knockout becoming more obese on the same diet. This is a genuine negative finding doing positive work, and the running text does not carry it.

entries.proposition: THE GLYCOLYTIC TARGET SET IS CONTEXT-DEPENDENT, AND THE PAPER'S FLAGSHIP GENE IS THE ONE THAT DROPS OUT. Under high-fat diet at 11 months PKM2 — the target with the highest ChIP enrichment in Fig 4f and the only one given protein-level confirmation by IHC in Fig 4e — is NOT elevated: it sits slightly below control and carries no mark. What is marked instead is PDK1, LDHA1 and ENO1. So 'HIF1alpha glycolytic targets rise when WWOX is lost' is not a fixed gene set; which members move depends on the metabolic context, and any transfer of this axis that names PKM2 as the invariant readout is unsupported.

entries.proposition: THE MOUSE-MODEL COUNTERPART OF THE PAPER'S HUMAN PREMISE, AND IT IS UNMARKED. Wwox mRNA in DEN-induced tumours of CONTROL mice is roughly half that of adjacent parenchyma — but the panel carries no significance mark, on n=3 versus n=3, while the legend defines the asterisk convention. The reduction of WWOX in spontaneous mouse liver tumours is therefore a direction with a plausible effect size and no declared statistic, and should not be cited as an established mouse datum.

entries.proposition: The absolute-grams measure recurs in the supplement, and its time course is not monotonic: liver weight separates at 1 month, does NOT separate at 3 months where the knockout is marginally lighter, and separates again at 6 months. A reader taking liver weight as a monotone proxy for accumulating tumour burden is contradicted by the paper's own intermediate timepoint.

entries.proposition: Liver injury under high-fat diet: serum ALT is roughly doubled in the knockout at 7 months and carries a significance mark. Recorded with its uncertainty — the knockout error bar spans roughly 45 to 73 against a control bar near 30, so the separation rests on a wide distribution.

entries.proposition: A YAP/Hippo-axis readout the main text does not carry: CTGF is elevated roughly 24-fold in the knockout at 1 month and again at 3 months, then returns to control levels at 6 and 10 months. The direction of travel is the opposite of the glycolytic programme, which only separates at 6 and 10 months — so the paper contains two transcriptional programmes with opposite time courses, and this supports the timing argument recorded at entries[24] rather than the paper's own causal ordering.
